title: Sys._enablelegacywindowsfsencoding is deprecated
summary: Python 3.13 deprecates sys._enablelegacywindowsfsencoding, to be removed in Python 3.16.

constraints: Keep the behavior of the code unchanged; check the replacement's argument and return-value differences.

steps.title: Replace the usage
steps.instructions: Replace each reported use of sys._enablelegacywindowsfsencoding with the PYTHONLEGACYWINDOWSFSENCODING environment variable.

verification.purpose: Run the tests with deprecation warnings as errors when pytest is used.
